title: Elements in $K_4$ and regulator maps of Fermat curves
summary: We construct explicit elements in the group $K_4^{(3)}$ of the Fermat curves $x^N+y^N=1$ for all $N\geq 3$. The construction, which is uniform in $N$, uses polylogarithmic complexes and a map of de Jeu to $K$-theory. We prove that the elements are non-trivial by showing that their images under Beilinson's regulator map are non-zero. Notably, we obtain explicit formulas for their regulator integrals involving special values of Zagier's trilogarithm function.
